# Build CSV rows from all Spotify playlists
spotify_token = apis.spotify.login(username='jamie-solomon@gmail.com', password=[p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='spotify'][0])['access_token']

# fetch playlist list (paginate fully)
playlists = []
i = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(
        access_token=spotify_token,
        query='',
        page_index=i,
        page_limit=20,
        sort_by='-created_at'
    )
    print('playlist_library page', i, 'count', len(page))
    if not page:
        break
    playlists.extend(page)
    i += 1
    if i > 200:
        break

playlist_ids = [p['playlist_id'] for p in playlists]
print('total_playlists', len(playlist_ids), 'ids', playlist_ids)

rows = []
for idx, pid in enumerate(playlist_ids):
    pl = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pid, access_token=spotify_token)
    print('playlist', idx, 'id', pid, 'title', pl['title'], 'songs', len(pl.get('songs', [])))
    for s in pl.get('songs', []):
        title = s.get('title', '')
        artists = s.get('artists', [])
        artist_names = [a.get('name', '') for a in artists]
        artists_field = '|'.join(artist_names)
        rows.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists_field, 'playlist_id': pid})

print('total_song_rows_collected', len(rows))
# show sample rows
print('sample_rows', rows[:10])
